items.title: Cracker Barrel Gets a New CEO After a Rocky Year, and the Stock Slides
items.summary: Cracker Barrel CEO Julie Masino, who oversaw the homestyle restaurant chain’s ill-fated rebranding efforts last year, is stepping down, the company said Monday.  The market reaction to the surprise announcement was sharp:  Cracker Barrel Old Country Store  stock slid 5.4% to $50.82 midday Monday.  Cracker Barrel made national headlines and was criticized by President Donald Trump last August when the company announced a new, streamlined logo design that clashed with its cozy, old-timey vibe.
